steps.clue: Collect the Fuse from the Library and the Circuit Board from the Director’s Quarters.
Repair the elevator to reach S.A.M. and Pack-a-Punch.
Kill a Lab Technician in the Mainframe Chamber and collect its Floppy Disk.
Use the Floppy Disk to obtain the Project Janus protocol word.
Decode the protocol using the Nursery chalkboard, then enter the code in the Service Tunnel.
Defeat the HVT Doppelghast and collect its Severed Arm.
Use the Severed Arm on the biometric scanner to obtain the Ray Gun Mark II.
Recover three canisters and craft Wraith Fire, Rot Blight and Preservation.
Complete their three Liminal rituals to charge the Sentinel Artifact.
Give the charged Sentinel Artifact to S.A.M., then defeat the Z-Rex.
